role: Bounded architectural development, not independent validation or promotion
seedUnit: Underlying seed across every policy, repeat, level and fork; six distinct seed blocks, not 34 independent observations

operations.creation: Local atomic creation lock plus server occupancy check before every creation. No other local research runner was active at preflight. Recheck server occupancy throughout; do not delete another runner's world.

priorEvidence.calendar: Rejected old implementation assumed 180 work minutes per local driver, assigned future service days and removed the incumbent gates. New capacity arm retains bounded count safeguards, does not impose service-day windows, and uses completed booking cohorts to change the price of outstanding work.
priorEvidence.joint: Rejected old implementation bought two uncertain requests jointly. New route arm credits only a feasible route involving an already won job; no second speculative quote win is required. Only 25% of modeled savings from open anchors, 50% from held anchors enter acquisition, and failed withdrawals preserve solo fulfillment.
priorEvidence.driverOffers: Old return-offer screen had few opportunities on the incumbent workload and was deferred without a live test. Reuse its tested feasibility helper on the changed capacity+route workload. Combined minus capacity-routes isolates this intervention; it is not a claim that a new offer heuristic is novel.

contrasts: mechanisms minus benchmark isolates stale-action filtering at level8; first-option and opening-cost fixes matter only below level4
capacity-routes minus mechanisms, with factorial interaction capacity-routes - capacity - routes + mechanisms
combined minus capacity-routes isolates driver offers under changed acquisition

sample.level8: Four familiar seeds, all six arms: 24 worlds
sample.levels1and4: Two familiar underlying seeds, mechanisms versus capacity at each level: 8 worlds
sample.randomizedPayments: Two further worlds on the first two level8 seeds, mechanism policy with at most20 eligible single-car posts per week randomized equally among92%,100%,108% of initial pay. Keep escalation. Record actual selected fee and probability1/3, failures and censoring. These sequential interventions interfere within a world; do not call40 orders40 independent weeks.

stopping: Complete all34frozen worlds regardless of profit. Each world has a600second wall-time budget checked before each tick. Runtime/budget failures stop new creation, retain partial events/decisions/worlds, and let already-running worlds finish. A failed study cannot promote. Five-minute occupancy wait budget. No tuning or positive interim stopping.

developmentGate.versus: mechanisms and preserved benchmark; report both
developmentGate.decision: Only an arm satisfying every criterion may be proposed as a finalist; no promotion from this development panel. Poor results reject this implementation, not the architectural hypothesis. Inspect all action errors, fines and recoveries.

analysis.uncertainty: Per-level paired week outcomes, 95% paired-t intervals and paired bootstrap sensitivity, exact one-sided95% binomial lower bounds under IID-week assumptions. With four or two adaptive development blocks these are descriptive, not confirmatory multiplicity-adjusted claims.
analysis.accounting: Reconcile every score margin to all ledger events. Never apportion a route fee arbitrarily to individual orders.
analysis.validation: No validation seeds generated here. Freeze one finalist before reserving untouched seeds. Follow search-integrity.json alpha spending, at least24 unique pairs, variance/effect-size sizing and explicit qualification-probability target. This trial uses no alpha allocation and earns no promotion claim.

onlineLearning.startingPrior: experiments/booking-response-prior.json; trained on57 historical seed groups, model comparison on19 distinct groups
onlineLearning.updates: At decision time use only award cohorts whose full120minute booking horizon has elapsed; exclude cohorts cancelled before the horizon. Regional observations weigh1 within70km and0.1 elsewhere. Starting prior has12 pseudo-orders. Each week starts from the same prior.
onlineLearning.capacity: Reserve pending probability plus half a Bernoulli standard deviation, capped1; outstanding unbooked work fully, booked work at0.25. Budget90 minutes per weighted home driver adjusted within[0.5,1.5] by the booking posterior/prior ratio. Opportunity price20c/min times squared load/budget capped3; positioning credit at most20% based only on prior observed request flow. Retain original daily/backlog gates at1.5x. These are frozen modeling assumptions, not driver assignment guarantees.
onlineLearning.pricing: Existing customer-choice model reoptimizes contribution with fulfillment proxy + capacity cost + booking-risk reserve - conservative anchored route credit. Original rescue payments remain except the separately randomized probes.
onlineLearning.dataBoundary: Seed, world IDs, final snapshots and reveal-only fields never enter live decision features. Public observations only. Offline and online model quality do not establish policy value.

knownLimits: Booked or moving low-charge reroutes cannot be amended through the API; incumbent charging-fine exposure remains and is logged.
Visible home drivers are not guaranteed supply; booking posterior is descriptive, not a causal driver-fee response.
The route credit uses a fixed uncertainty discount, not a calibrated anchor-survival model.
No private-address expansion, new note parser, whole-game optimality claim or leaderboard extrapolation.
Full process restarts abort the research trial. Transient recovery preserves model, RNG, route links and probe budget.

amendment.reason: v1 operational CPU failure; five completed worlds, two interrupted worlds and all27unstarted trials retained. See docs/value-development-interruption.json. The affected worlds were archived before administrative closure without further dispatch actions.
amendment.policyChange: No price, payment, learning, routing, offer-feasibility or risk parameters changed. Skip provably ineligible/stale drivers before constructing offers, compute immutable open-gig features once per call, and refresh shared quotas before each driver. Behavioral equivalence test checks actions and quota state against frozenv1.
amendment.logging: Journal decision telemetry after every tick and event batch, in addition to terminal artifacts. A fatal process exit can lose at most the current unfinished batch's telemetry; public server events remain recoverable.
amendment.newFreeze: Repeat the complete34-world development panel under a new source/prior/protocol/launcher manifest. Repeats remain the same six underlying seed blocks. No claim from the interrupted panel is promoted.
